minor.issue: Mentions LP-PRP for knee OA conflicting with newer evidence but omits the parallel caveat that the LR-PRP-for-patellar-tendinopathy consensus conflicts with an RCT showing no superiority over saline.
Could note attrition across rounds (24 -> 21 -> 20 respondents) so readers know the final consensus reflects 20 physicians.
'Knee osteoarthritis symptoms' should specify early OA as worded in the source abstract.
States physicians 'representing 26 NFL teams plus NFL London' rated statements; only 24 completed round 1 and 20 completed the final round; 75%/<10% threshold and 78-item start not given.

No agreement percentages; omits that PRP consensus was not reached for Achilles, hamstring, AC, adductor, sports hernia, syndesmotic and meniscal indications, and omits the IV stem-cell and placental/amniotic statements.
Omits possible industry-tie bias acknowledged by the authors and the noted divergence of some statements (LP-PRP for knee OA, LR-PRP for patellar tendinopathy) from more recent evidence.
Loading, sleep, nutrition and workload advice is not derived from the consensus.
Generic RTP criteria not from the source; should state the consensus sets no return-to-sport criteria.

note: Both are faithful in direction, but A gives the exact item-level agreement levels, non-consensus indications, sample flow and author-acknowledged divergences from newer evidence, whereas B is generic and adds unsourced practice advice.
